mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing below 5.0% predicts stronger labor market conditions, reducing unemployment risk and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in <30% of instances where UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, or the IC score is below 0.1 over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial activity) predicts stronger economic momentum, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising, or the interaction effect's IC score is below 0.15 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS predicts higher interest rates, compressing growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of tightening cycles, or the IC score exceeds 0.2 over the period.
